sloka: रावणं प्रेक्ष्य हृष्टात्मा युद्धाय समुपागमत् ।सर्वयत्नेन महता वधे तस्य धृतो ऽभवत् ।। ६.१०७.३० ।।
transliteration: rāvaṇaṁ prekṣya hṛṣṭātmā yuddhāya samupāgamat ।sarvayatnena mahatā vadhe tasya dhṛto 'bhavat ।। 6.107.30 ।।

translations.english: Sipping water three times and looking at Aditya, the valiant Rama getting purified, with devotion chanted the supreme with delight. Then he took up his bow, fixing his eyes at Ravana, and advanced for war with an allout effort determined to destroy Ravana.
